findings.finding: The tombstone guard's load-bearing edit site (outbound_differ) is not enumerated as an edit target. After BindingStore._retire pops the live binding (binding_store.py:577), get_jira_key(local_id) returns None (outbound_differ.py:510), so the retired local ticket flows into _compute_outbound_create_mutation (outbound_differ.py:512-521) — the exact place the 'NO outbound create' guard must intercept. The plan names outbound_differ only for READING (_safe_get_issue / _is_retired), never as the module the guard edits.
findings.location: Acceptance Criteria — 'a local ticket whose binding was retired on a confirmed 404 gets NO outbound create'

findings.finding: The plan removes route_inbound_probe (the sole producer of the (inbound, delete, reason=hard_delete) mutation) and reverses ADR 0028 c244 to tombstone semantics, but its removal set does not touch the c244 hard-delete re-create machinery that route_inbound_probe feeds — leaving code that is both dead (its only feeder is deleted) and semantically contradictory to the new tombstone guard.
findings.location: Acceptance Criteria — 'the dead chain is removed' AC and the c244 ADR-correction AC
findings.suggested_fix: Add the c244 re-create consumer chain to the removal set (or an explicit retention rationale) alongside route_inbound_probe: since route_inbound_probe's ARCHIVED_OR_MOVED branch is that chain's sole feeder, removing the router orphans apply_inbound._apply_inbound_delete's hard_delete branch, _build_hard_delete_recreate, applier.py:452's create_after_hard_delete handling, and test_hard_delete_recreate.py. Tie this to the ADR c244 correction so the tombstone semantics and the code state agree.

findings.finding: The 'Why it matters' claim that ticket b9b8 reworked a live DC cell named `test_a_deleted_dc_issue_is_planned_as_an_inbound_probe` is refuted: b9b8's actual scope is title-mirroring (`outbound_field_diff._INBOUND_MIRRORED_FIELDS`), and no such test exists in the repo.

The new method BindingStore.is_retired_local(local_id) requires a local_id->retired lookup the plan does not specify: bindings-retired.json is keyed by jira_key (each entry carries local_id inside), so is_retired_local must reverse-scan retired entries. The AC pins duck-typed tolerance but not this resolution path.
